SafeMath.safeAdd, pure checked addition using require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub, pure checked subtraction using require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul, pure checked multiplication using division check.
SafeMath.safeDiv, pure division requiring a non-zero divisor.

Accepts ownership after require(msg.sender == newOwner) and emits OwnershipTransferred.

Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked uint subtraction.

Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance with safeSub on allowed[from][msg.sender] and moves balances.
Constant getter returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy before state settles.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing all plain Ether transfers.
onlyOwner function that calls an arbitrary external ERC20Interface contract to move tokens to owner.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowances.

External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, which requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes the caller allowance allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall grants allowance to msg.sender-selected spender and triggers a callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier applied to msg.sender.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the destination balance.
Whatever constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Whatever constructor writes the name state variable.
Whatever constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Whatever constructor sets the initial _totalSupply.
Whatever constructor pre-loads balances of the fixed holder address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes into the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed nested mapping before the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the owner state variable as the transfer destination.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership writes owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state assignment.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index balances in balanceOf.
to parameter is used as the credited balance key in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd in transfer.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
from parameter is the debited balance key in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited balance key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
Caller-supplied spender becomes both the allowance key and the external callback target.
tokens parameter is written to the allowance mapping.
Caller-supplied data is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary external contract that is called.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external token contract.
safeAdd operand a flows into the checked addition.
safeAdd operand b flows into the checked addition.
Local c holds the safeAdd result returned to the caller.
safeSub minuend a flows into the checked subtraction.
safeSub subtrahend b flows into the require guard and subtraction.
Local c holds the safeSub result returned to the caller.
safeMul operand a flows into the checked multiplication.
safeMul operand b flows into the checked multiplication.
Local c holds the safeMul result returned to the caller.
safeDiv dividend a flows into the division.
safeDiv divisor b is checked with require(b > 0).
Local c holds the safeDiv result returned to the caller.
approveAndCall transfers control to the external spender contract via receiveApproval.
The attacker-controlled receiveApproval callback re-enters the token contract while the call is in flight.
transferAnyERC20Token transfers control to an owner-supplied external ERC20 contract.
The external token transfer can call back into this contract before the owner operation completes.
totalSupply executes an unchecked uint subtraction rather than using SafeMath.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend, allowing underflow if it exceeds the supply.
